997-7084-8337.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, scrying 1.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, M'Ress triggers, creating two 1/1 red Officer creature tokens
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, scrying 1.
Repeat.

uses.n: Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements

6867-6884-7117.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang, the Last Airbender.
Cast Aang, the Last Airbender from exile by paying {0} due to Aang, Master of Elements.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang, the Last Airbender enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

1818-1981-2034-2415.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1818-1981-2034-2415.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

2292-2738-4871-6255.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Zahur, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Zahur trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Repeat.

5921-6575.description:
Cast Mirror Room by paying {2}{U}
When Mirror Room enters, it triggers, creating a token copy of Esper Terra that is a Reflection in addition to its other types. It'll enter with a lore counter on it.
Put the Esper Terra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Esper Terra token's first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of Mirror Room.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

2079-3010-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2079-3010-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Moonblade Shinobi, triggering Breath of Fury and Moonblade Shinobi.
Resolve the Moonblade Shinobi trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

215-1129-4785.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Allies.
215-1129-4785.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Harabaz Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Harabaz Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1988-2829-3490-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
1988-2829-3490-7426.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Blade of the Bloodchief triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat

1558-2557-2638-3756-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2557-2638-3756-4231.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Parallel Lives.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2829-4559-4802-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
2829-4559-4802-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2267-6798-7084.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

457-711-4067-4639.description:
Activate Urza by tapping Unctus, adding {U}.
Activate Unctus by paying {U/P}, causing Fallowsage to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Urza by tapping Fallowsage, adding {U}.
Fallowsage triggers, causing you to draw two cards and discard a card.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Fallowsage.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

4644-4885-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Tidewater Minion.
Activate one of the Tidewater Minion tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Tidewater Minion token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1492-2866-3698-4986.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1492-2866-3698-4986.description:
Cast Welding Jar by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Scrap Trawler and Welding Jar enter, Grinding Station triggers twice, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Welding Jar from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Repeat.

1330-4090-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters, it triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to you and a creature. The damage that would be dealt to you is dealt to Truefire Captain instead due to Pariah.
Truefire Captain triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to an applicable target.

5231-6871-6879-6880.description:
Cast Stonework Puma by paying {3}.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Stonework Puma.
When Stonework Puma dies, Haru triggers, returning Stonework Puma from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.

1168-1418-1651-1863-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1168-1418-1651-1863-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1168-1418-1651-1863-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers twice due to Virtue of Knowledge, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

781-1055-6497.description:
Cast Traumatize by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing the player named by Sewer Nemesis to mill half their library, rounded down.
Activate Sewer Nemesis by tapping it, causing the player to mill cards equal to the cards in their graveyard, likely milling the remainder of their library.
781-1055-6497.notes: The player will mill their entire library unless, when the combo was started, their graveyard was empty and their deck size was odd. In this case, you can tap another creature via Phenax or use another method to mill the one remaining card.

4639-4853-4917-6429.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls four or more nonbasic lands.
4639-4853-4917-6429.description:
Activate Unctus by tapping it, causing Jan Jansen to become a blue artifact until end of turn.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing Razorlash Transmogrant.
Jan Jansen and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Jan Jansen trigger, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Jan Jansen.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability from step 2, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Razorlash Transmogrant by paying {B}{B}, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2440-5200-5663.easyPrerequisites: Sword of the Paruns attached to Cayth.
2440-5200-5663.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token.
You control at least four creatures that share a creature type with the creature token.
Cayth does not have summoning sickness.
2440-5200-5663.description:
Activate Cayth by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of a creature token you control.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with it.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Cayth.
Repeat.
2440-5200-5663.notes: You may begin the combo with less creatures that share a type with the token, but you will need additional mana to do so until you begin to break even from Mana Echoes' trigger. Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Cayth to get infinite proliferate.

1946-2512-2603.description:
Activate Nomads en-Kor's first ability by paying {0}, targeting Daru Spiritualist.
Daru Spiritualist triggers, causing itself to get +0/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Nomads en-Kor ability, causing the next one damage dealt to Nomads en-Kor this turn to be dealt to Daru Spiritualist instead.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Cast Worthy Cause by paying {W} and sacrificing Daru Spiritualist, causing you to gain life equal to Daru Spiritualist's toughness.

663-2390.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal noncombat damage to a creature an opponent controls.
663-2390.description:
Attempt to deal noncombat damage to a creature an opponent controls, instead putting that many -1/-1 counters on it due to Soul-Scar Mage.
All Will Be One triggers, putting that many -1/-1 counters on a creature an opponent controls.
Repeat step 2.

uses.n: Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios // Journey to the Oracle

1401-2353-4050-4300.notablePrerequisites: You control at least eight lands, five of which enter the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {5}.
1401-2353-4050-4300.description:
Activate five lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}.
Activate Meloku five times by paying {5} and returning the five lands from the battlefield to your hand, creating five 1/1 Illusion creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Illusions, adding {2}{G}{G}.
Cast Journey to the Oracle by paying {2}{G}{G}.
Niv-Mizzet's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet's first ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve Journey to the Oracle, putting at least five lands from your hand onto the battlefield, then causing you to discard a card and Journey to the Oracle to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-2907-3861.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2907-3861.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it, Scute Swarm, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Scute Swarm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Scute Swarm trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

364-813-1987-3941.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Coveted Jewel and Scholar of the Ages, blinking them.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Coveted Jewel enters the battlefield, draw three cards.
Repeat.
